tagline: A sheltered Bosphorus bay turned luxury marina — upscale shopping, waterfront dining, and one of Istanbul's most scenic natural harbours.

items.name: İstinye Park AVM Cafés
items.description: The premium İstinye Park shopping centre has excellent café options in a beautiful open-air design. One of Istanbul's best malls.

items.name: İstinye Koyu Balık Restoranları
items.description: Fish restaurants around the İstinye bay marina with boats moored outside. A beautiful and authentic waterfront dining experience.

items.name: İstinye Park Restaurants
items.description: A wide range of quality restaurants within the İstinye Park complex — reliable for business lunches or a quality meal in the area.

items.name: İstinye Koyu (Bay) Walk
items.description: A sheltered, boat-filled natural bay with a beautiful fish market at the waterfront. Walk around the perimeter for excellent views.

items.name: İstinye Park Shopping
items.description: One of Istanbul's most beautiful open-air premium malls with international luxury brands and excellent restaurant options.

tips: İstinye is best reached by bus from Beşiktaş (25D route) or taxi from Sarıyer metro.
The bay area and fish market are early morning at their most atmospheric. Worth a 9am visit.
İstinye Park is one of the genuinely nicer shopping malls in Istanbul — worth a dedicated visit.
Walk south along the Bosphorus to Yeniköy for a pleasant combined half-day.
